migration.migration_reason: Preserved paid Language Quality findings were independently re-adjudicated against the current fixed five-component design rubric. Legacy normalized scores were retained only for audit and were not used to derive component levels. The snapshot is bound to exact source evidence and the current validator recomputes scores.

recertifier.provider_model_provenance_claim: No Anthropic/Sonnet call is claimed for these reconstructed judgments.

component_findings.abstraction_ceremony: Recertified level 2 under the current criterion: Reusable abstractions such as types, interfaces/traits/generics or equivalent mechanisms can be declared and consumed without excessive scaffolding. Evidence basis: Static inspection of template/programs/go/micro/*.go and adversarial/*.go. Conciseness measured qualitatively via token/line overhead required by idiomatic Go for the same algorithmic content compared against typical modern languages. | mb04.go (75000x4000 float accumulation microbenchmark): 83 lines, includes explicit error handling for strconv.Atoi, explicit struct definitions with manual methods, and verbose printf-based formatted output. | Go requires explicit if err != nil handling rather than exceptions or Result combinators, adding boilerplate per fallible call. | No generics-based shorthand used; manual indexed for-loops throughout rather than functional/iterator idioms. | Struct + explicit method receivers add syntactic overhead vs languages with primary constructors/data classes. | No operator overloading, no default parameters, no expression-bodied members; numeric workload logic fully spelled out per line. | Adversarial corpus (ADV-01..26) shows many small single-purpose files consistent with Go's non-generic explicit style; ADV-21.go at 200KB shows repetition needed for some stress cases.

metric.code_efficiency_conciseness.limitations: Comparison-language reprojection requires the preserved paid source evidence plus the historical program/workload/toolchain inputs to match the current shard; mismatches remain misses.
metric.code_efficiency_conciseness.selection_rule: Judge intrinsic mandatory ceremony for the same kinds of ordinary programs. Do not reuse raw LOC/bytes/tokens as the score and do not reward external libraries.

component_findings.consistency_regular_forms: Recertified level 4 under the current criterion: Similar concepts use regular forms with few special-case spellings or context-dependent surface rules. Evidence basis: Static inspection of the same Go source corpus for naming clarity, structural regularity, comment density, and syntactic noise. | gofmt-enforced canonical formatting yields uniform layout across all files, a strong readability asset from tooling-enforced single style. | Small function bodies and single level of abstraction per function make control flow easy to trace. | Explicit types everywhere reduce ambiguity for readers at the cost of some verbosity, net positive for numeric code readability. | Clear doc comments precede important functions explaining algorithmic intent. | No operator overloading or macro/metaprogramming; code executes exactly as written with no hidden control flow. | Multiple return values and consistent error-checking idiom aid pattern recognition despite added line count. | Lack of pattern matching/algebraic data types forces if/else and switch dispatch in complex adversarial samples, slightly less readable than exhaustive pattern matches elsewhere.
